document: Whisk one cup of flour, one tablespoon of sugar, and a pinch of salt. Stir in one cup of milk and one egg until the batter is smooth. Heat a pan, pour a small ladle of batter, and cook until bubbles form. Flip once and serve warm.

Bring one cup of water to a simmer. Stir in half a cup of rolled oats and a pinch of salt. Cook for five minutes, stirring so the oats do not stick. Turn off the heat and let the pot stand for two minutes.
